newsitem.title: EGYPT: Misr Exterior Bank posts strong 9-mo earnings. [CORRECTED 09:40 GMT]
newsitem.headline: Misr Exterior Bank posts strong 9-mo earnings. [CORRECTED 09:40 GMT]

text.p: (Corrects to amend headline as new figures are for first nine months of 1996, compared with the whole of 1995.)
Misr Exterior Bank said on Wednesday it earned 55.03 million pounds ($16.21 million) in the first nine months of 1996, against 59.10 million pounds in the whole of calendar 1995.
Total assets rose 14 percent during the nine-month period, to 3.23 billion pounds from 2.83 billion at the end of 1995.

Shareholders' funds at the end of September 1996, including the profits for nine-month period, were worth 246.052 million pounds, or 337 pounds a share, against 191.019 million at the end of December 1995.
Divided between the 730,000 shares, earnings in the nine-month period were 75.39 pounds a share. The shares last traded on the Egyptian stock exchange at 1,000.00 pounds.
Misr Exterior Bank began in 1982 as a joint venture between the Egyptian state's Banque Misr and the Spanish bank Banco Exterior de Espana.

Both banks have reduced their stakes by selling to mutual funds and other investors. Banque Misr, once the dominant partner with 51 percent, held 19.39 percent of the equity at the end of 1996, the bank said.

Banco Exterior de Espana has cut its stake from 40 percent to 29.34 percent. The other shareholders are Egyptian individuals (14.44 percent), mutual funds (14.08 percent) and industrial establishments (11 percent), it said.
